answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1406 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the prism. Flooding registration pushes an adversary to the back of the grove queue while honest participants promoted earlier still earns. The ferrous index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Each impostor pays 15 dollars up front. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
